messages.威力が高くコインも多い、癖の少ない斬撃アタッカー。破裂がなくても戦える。破裂編成: A straightforward Slash attacker with high Power and many Coins, capable of fighting without Rupture. In Rupture teams, use S1 followed by S2 to reach at least 6 Rupture and gain the bonuses from Weakness Analyzed and Rupture.
messages.S2「対象解体」(主力): 3コイン。マッチ勝利時に破裂回数+3、Ⅰコインで破裂: **S2 — Dissect Target (main skill)**: 3 Coins. On Clash Win, adds +3 Rupture Count, and Coin Ⅰ inflicts 3 Rupture. On hit, Coin Ⅲ inflicts Weakness Analyzed next turn if the target has at least 6 Rupture. Gains +1 Coin Power for every 6 Rupture on the target, up to 2.
messages.弱点分析: 1ターンの間、攻撃タイプ耐性の「抵抗」「普通」のうち1つをランダムに: **Weakness Analyzed**: For 1 turn, randomly weakens one of the target's Endured or Normal Attack Type resistances by +0.2.
messages.S1「予測分析」: Ⅱコイン的中時に破裂3を付与する。対象の破裂3につきコイン威: **S1 — Predictive Analysis**: On hit, Coin Ⅱ inflicts 3 Rupture. Gains +1 Coin Power for every 3 Rupture on the target, up to 2. Land it before S2 to set up.
messages.S3「プロファイリング」: 使用時に、対象の破裂3につきダメージ量+10%(最大: **S3 — Profiling**: On use, +10% damage for every 3 Rupture on the target, up to 20/50%. Because it checks on use, the bonus does not drop even if Rupture decreases during the attack. It inflicts little Rupture, so it is best as a finisher.
messages.低い耐久: 防御レベルは人格Lv-2。被弾すると混乱しやすい。: **Low durability**: Her Defense Level is Identity Lv -2, and she staggers easily when hit.
messages.バトルパッシブ「お茶が冷める前に…」(暴食×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 弱点・: **Combat passive — Before the Tea Cools... (3 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When attacking with an affinity the target is Fatal or Weak to (resistance above 1), gains Poise equal to the target's Rupture, up to 20 per turn. It only grants Potency, so the benefit is limited.
messages.基本はS2を主力に、そのまま殴るだけで火力を出せる。破裂を活かすなら、S1で破裂: By default, just attacking with S2 as her main skill deals solid damage. To make use of Rupture, win a Clash with S2 against a target that already has 3 Rupture from S1. The +3 Rupture Count and Coin Ⅰ's 3 Rupture bring it to 6 or more, and Coin Ⅲ then inflicts Weakness Analyzed. Finish with S3 to add damage based on Rupture. This sequence has several conditions. The Rupture from Coin Ⅱ of S1 has only 1 Count, so it disappears if an ally's attack lands before S2. S2 cannot reach 6 unless Coin Ⅰ hits. Only 1 Rupture Count remains after S2, so S3's damage bonus depends on Rupture lasting that long. Keeping Rupture at 6 or more requires allies who are good at inflicting it.
